summary: Iteration 6 full-stack test of DBG Signs CRM covering the new feature batch. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (32 tests) and modernized the three stale regression suites; final run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -n 0 -q` => 111/111 PASS. Verified: material-categories GET (presets incl. 'Marketing Materials') + POST custom (case-insensitive duplicate 400, blank 400, preset-collision 400) + DELETE (404 on repeat) + RBAC (salesman read 200 / write 403, unauth 401); commission = materials-only at SELLING price (2-line fixture: material $90, labor+machine > 0 => commission_base 90.00, amount 9.00 at 10%; explicitly asserted base != subtotal and base < subtotal), salesman auto-rate 10% (base 60 => 6.00) and /api/commissions rows carry base=commission_base; PUT /api/settings persists default_tax_rate (7.75) while retaining shop_sqft_per_hr/machine_sqft_per_hr/shop_rate_per_hr, salesman write 403; POST /api/sales-orders creates SO-XXXX (regex-checked) with commission block, invalid status falls back to 'open', PUT edits status+totals, void/reactivate toggles; admin-password deletes for estimates/sales-orders/invoices (wrong pw => 403 'Incorrect admin password' and doc still present, no body => 422, correct pw => 200 and gone, salesman => 403 for all three); void exclusion (dashboard receivable drops by invoice total, invoice_count -1, /api/receivables/overdue?days=45 excludes it, create-intent on voided => 400, reactivate restores dashboard numbers); STRIPE: create-intent returns pi_..._secret_... + pk_ key + amount, 400 on paid/voided/zero-amount, 404 unknown invoice, 401 unauth, customer can pay only OWN invoice (403 on another customer's), status/{unknown} => 404, webhook rejects bad signature 400, and a real PaymentIntent confirmed server-side with pm_card_visa flipped the invoice to status=paid/paid_via=stripe through GET /api/payments/status/{id}; portal-accounts full lifecycle (create => portal_enabled true/suspended false/linked customer with tier+terms, duplicate email 400, customer login 200 and 403 on staff endpoints, suspend => login 403 'suspended' and existing session 403, reactivate => login OK, delete => login 401 while customer business record survives with portal_enabled false, 404 on repeat delete, salesman 403 on all 4 endpoints), portal_enabled=false => /api/portal/orders 403 'not enabled', portal invoice list excludes voided and other customers' invoices. Auth playbook re-verified: bcrypt hash starts with $2b$, login sets HttpOnly cookies with no token in body, CORS allow_credentials with explicit FRONTEND_URL origin, brute-force 429 lockout after 5 failures (existing test passes). FRONTEND (Playwright, 1920x1080): admin login -> dashboard shows Accounts Payable card + Record Bill + Add Material + Portal Accounts nav; salesman dashboard hides stat-payable/qa-bill/qa-material and has no Settings/Team/Portal Accounts nav, /portal-accounts redirects to /dashboard, no delete buttons on Invoices, no Categories button on Materials; Materials Categories dialog adds custom category (duplicate shows 'already exists'), dropdown lists all 6 presets incl. Marketing Materials + custom, delete works; Settings default tax rate 6.5 saved and persisted across reload with throughput fields intact; New Sales Order builder seeds Tax=6.5 from settings, statuses open/in_production/fulfilled, commission block preview '$50.00 x 10% = $5.00' (materials only), SO created (SO-0046), void -> disappears from Active and appears in Voided tab, reactivate returns it, delete with wrong password shows 'Incorrect admin password' and keeps the row, correct password deletes; Invoices page tabs + Pay Now dialog renders the embedded Stripe PaymentElement (2 iframes) and a real 4242 card payment inside the dialog flipped INV-0065 to PAID; customer Portal shows portal-pay-<id> for the unpaid invoice, embedded payment succeeded and the row flipped to PAID with the Pay button gone; portal_enabled=false customer sees the 'Access unavailable' portal-error panel with no unhandled JS error; suspended customer login shows the suspended message in login-error. All UI_TEST/TEST_it6 data was cleaned up and default_tax_rate restored to 0.

minor.issue: Void/reactivate is require_staff, so a salesman can void any invoice/SO (removing it from receivables/dashboard/portal) even though deleting requires the admin password. Confirm this is intended; if not, gate void behind require_admin (frontend also renders void/reactivate buttons for salesmen - 9 void buttons visible on the salesman Invoices page).

Password is verified before existence, so deleting an unknown id with a wrong password returns 403 rather than 404. Harmless but slightly leaks ordering; also a missing body returns 422 instead of 400.

ui_bugs.issue: loadStripe(process.env.REACT_APP_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) runs at module scope, so when the key is not baked into the bundle the app throws 'Expected publishable key to be of type string, got type undefined' and CRA's red runtime-error overlay covers the WHOLE app (it was reproduced on /login before I restarted the frontend to pick up the newly added env var). Recommend lazy-initialising Stripe inside the dialog and falling back to the publishable_key already returned by POST /api/payments/create-intent, with a friendly error instead of a thrown exception.

design_issues.screen: Pay Now dialog (staff Invoices + customer Portal)
issues: automatic_payment_methods=enabled makes the PaymentElement render an accordion (Card / Bank / Affirm / Cash App / Amazon Pay / Klarna) so the card fields are collapsed one click deep; the request was an embedded CARD form. Consider payment_method_types=['card'] or PaymentElement layout/defaultCollapsed tuning so the card fields are shown immediately.

design_issues.screen: Invoices / Sales Orders / Portal Accounts lists
issues: Lots of leftover seed/test rows from earlier iterations (many invoices/SOs with customer 'Unknown' because their customer was deleted, plus 5 'TEST_Portal User' portal logins). Consider showing a clearer placeholder than 'Unknown' for orphaned customers and purging the old TEST_ rows.

action_items: Make Stripe init resilient in PayNowDialog (lazy loadStripe + use publishable_key from create-intent) so a missing REACT_APP_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY cannot crash the whole SPA with the runtime overlay.
Decide whether void/reactivate should be admin-only (currently require_staff, salesman can void invoices/SOs while deletes need the admin password).
Optional UX: show the Stripe card fields expanded by default instead of behind the payment-method accordion.
Optional data hygiene: purge legacy TEST_ invoices/SOs/portal logins and handle 'Unknown' customer labels for orphaned docs.
critical_code_review_comments: PayNowDialog.jsx module-scope loadStripe() throws on undefined key - move inside the component and prefer the publishable_key returned by /api/payments/create-intent (server already returns it).
server.py is 1861 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, docs, payments, portal, reporting) - it is past the 700-line guideline.
verify_admin_password runs before get_or_404 in the delete endpoints, so unknown-id + bad password returns 403 instead of 404; reorder for accurate status codes.
GET /api/payments/status/{id} silently swallows stripe.error.StripeError; log the exception so Stripe outages are diagnosable.
CORS falls back to a hardcoded http://localhost:3000 when FRONTEND_URL is missing - FRONTEND_URL is set today, but prefer failing fast per env-var policy.

rca_of_the_issue: The only real defect found is the module-scope loadStripe() in PayNowDialog.jsx: because CRA inlines process.env at dev-server/build start, the freshly added REACT_APP_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY was undefined in the running bundle and @stripe/stripe-js threw 'Expected publishable key to be of type string' during module evaluation, which surfaced as a full-screen CRA runtime-error overlay on every route (including /login). Restarting the frontend (env reload) cleared it and all Stripe flows then worked end-to-end, but the code path remains fragile - initialise Stripe lazily with the publishable_key returned by /api/payments/create-intent and render a graceful error instead. The 12 pre-existing pytest failures were stale assertions in iteration 4/5 suites (commission on full subtotal, settings equality, deletes without the new password body), not product bugs; they were updated to the new intended behaviour and one cascading failure (an un-restored settings PUT) disappeared with them.
